BiblicalUsage: Hendekatos means eleventh, and Jesus uses it for the workers hired last. In Matthew 20:6 the master finds men standing idle at the eleventh hour, in Matthew 20:9 they receive a penny like the rest, and in Revelation 21:20 the eleventh foundation of the city is jacinth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the eleventh hour is the gospel for latecomers: the men hired last are paid first, and the stone laid eleventh is still a foundation. God does not keep office hours, and his grace is not a wage.
